competitors.description: Extra large kilo-sized coffee canister with patented inner plunger lid that removes excess oxygen, holds 2.2 lbs of coffee beans

target_users: Coffee enthusiasts and home baristas who buy large bags of fresh roasted coffee and want to preserve maximum freshness over time.
core_scenario: Storing bulk quantities of freshly roasted coffee beans at home while removing oxygen to maintain peak flavor and aroma for weeks.
pain_points: Traditional airtight containers still trap oxygen inside with the coffee, causing beans to go stale quickly and lose flavor after opening large bags.
